capabilities: Speak selected text aloud via the editor context menu
Trigger speech from the command palette or a hotkey
Auto-detect the language of the selection by character set
Set a default fallback language among 23 supported languages
Adjust speech rate from 0.5x to 2.0x in settings
disambiguation: Not an audio recorder; it only speaks existing text aloud using system voices.
extras: Desktop only, since it relies on the Web Speech API; requires Obsidian >= 0.15.0. Works offline using built-in system voices with no API key or internet connection. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to have selected text spoken aloud, especially across mixed-language notes.
summary: Text-to-speech plugin that reads selected text aloud via the Web Speech API, with automatic language detection and adjustable speech rate.
